* Fix the extra space when Add forward link is not shown

* Redirect to domain list or side domains page after detach (#99059)

* Fix spacings in domain forwarding card

data.title: Fix domain getting stuck in broken settings page after detaching
data.body:
<!--
Link a related issue to this PR. If the PR does not immediately resolve the issue,
for example, it requires a separate deployment to production, avoid
using the "fixes" keyword and instead attach the [Status] Fix Inbound label to
the linked issue.
-->

Related to https://github.com/Automattic/wp-calypso/issues/99003

## Proposed Changes

When domain gets detached, the URL immediately becomes invalid, because the URL contains the old site's slug, which is no longer attached with the domain. This causes the page to be broken.

But we can't just switch to the default domain-only site's slug, because it can take an uncertain amount of time to get attached to the default site for this domain. When the detach request is sent to the backend, it creates and async background job. So the time it can take is not fixed.

So the safest path to avoid showing a broken UI to the user is to send them back to the domain list, or site list in case they were in site context. Though it's not always the best behavior, but it prevents the broken UI being exposed to the user.

Also, we added the delay because, though uncertain, roughly the detached domain gets attached to the default domain within 5-7 seconds and gets properly detached from the old site. So the user doesn't end up seeing the detached domain still being attached to the old site even after redirection.

It handles the redirection in three different cases -

- All domains list
- Site context
- From "Manage site"

## Why are these changes being made?
<!--

particularly when researching old changes in history. Record an explanation of

Related to https://github.com/Automattic/wp-calypso/issues/99003

When domain gets detached, the URL immediately becomes invalid, because the URL contains the old site's slug, which is no longer attached with the domain. This causes the page to be broken.

But we can't just switch to the default domain-only site's slug, because it can take an uncertain amount of time to get attached to the default site for this domain. When the detach request is sent to the backend, it creates and async background job. So the time it can take is not fixed.

So the safest path to avoid showing a broken UI to the user is to send them back to the domain list, or site list in case they were in site context. Though it's not always the best behavior, but it prevents the broken UI being exposed to the user.

Also, we added the delay because, though uncertain, roughly the detached domain gets attached to the default domain within 5-7 seconds and gets properly detached from the old site. So the user doesn't end up seeing the detached domain still being attached to the old site even after redirection.

It handles the redirection in three different cases -

- All domains list
- Site context
- From "Manage site"

- Go to "/domains/manage"
- Click on a domain that is attached to a site
- Click on "Detach"
- Make sure you get redirected to the domains list afterwards

Related to https://github.com/Automattic/wp-calypso/issues/99003

## Proposed Changes

When domain gets detached, the URL immediately becomes invalid, because the URL contains the old site's slug, which is no longer attached with the domain. This causes the page to be broken.

But we can't just switch to the default domain-only site's slug, because it can take an uncertain amount of time to get attached to the default site for this domain. When the detach request is sent to the backend, it creates and async background job. So the time it can take is not fixed.

So the safest path to avoid showing a broken UI to the user is to send them back to the domain list, or site list in case they were in site context. Though it's not always the best behavior, but it prevents the broken UI being exposed to the user.

Also, we added the delay because, though uncertain, roughly the detached domain gets attached to the default domain within 5-7 seconds and gets properly detached from the old site. So the user doesn't end up seeing the detached domain still being attached to the old site even after redirection.

It handles the redirection in three different cases -

- All domains list
- Site context
- From "Manage site"
